title: the rules a member agrees to before publishing a Page

criteria.text: A member becomes a creator by completing one step before publishing a Page, and takes it again before every new Page; creator status derives from the agreement record and authorship: no account type, no stored role column, no mode flag
criteria.note: `group.activate` refuses without `rulesVersion === RULES_VERSION` on every publish and writes one `creator_rules_agreements` row per Page (member, Page, version, time); `members.maker_mode_enabled` is gone (#908) [V]. Since #1135 (10-31) the agreement is the one line 'By posting you agree to the Terms' with no tick; the publish action still sends the version. Checked: `[guards F082.1]` in `tests/f082-rules-before-publish-db.test.tsx`, updated in #1135: a second Page is refused without a fresh agreement, no checkbox, and a standing scan that `members` and `groups` carry no role, type, mode or badge column [V]. Reviewed: #326, #493, #908 carry `Reviewed by:`, but #1135 (which rewrote the step and the guard) says 'second session pending' and carries `needs-fix`, so no. Shipped: Deploy health green on f89b294 and 3df9260. Smoked: no route for the publish card.

criteria.text: Agreeing is the attestation; nothing is typed and no free text is stored. Self-attestation only: no document upload, no ID, no selfie, no photo, no third-party lookup, no automated check, no human approval queue
criteria.note: Publish has no input, upload or tick, only Publish and the Terms line; the agreements table has no free-text column; `group.activate` calls no lookup, approval or queue [V BeforeYouPublish.tsx, migration 20261007190000]. Reviewed: rewritten in #1135 ('second session pending'), so no. Checked: the old `[guards F082.2]` sat on the removed rules block; no marker names this half now (#1203). Shipped: green on 3df9260. Smoked: no route for the publish card.

criteria.text: The step is fixed statements, presented as rules with the reason for each, which the member agrees to abide by
criteria.note: Spec conflict. There is no rules list with a reason each any more: Don, 2026-10-31 (#1135): 'drop the Rules page; one line at publish', 'By posting you agree to the Terms' [V BeforeYouPublish.tsx, creator-rules.ts, next.config.ts]. The scenario has no dated `## Rulings` line for it (the PR says 'Scenario F082 ... needs updating'), so this cannot be marked retired here. Routed to `scope-scenario`: record the ruling and retire or restate criteria 2b and 6's 'rules'.

criteria.text: Nothing attested renders to peers as a badge, tier, score, label or public claim
criteria.note: `creator_rules_agreements` is named only by `group.activate`; RLS on, zero policies, grants revoked from anon and authenticated [V migration 20261007190000, grep src]. Checked: `[guards F082.3]` in `tests/f082-rules-before-publish-db.test.tsx` (RLS, no policy or grant, both roles refused, no view or function reads it, only `group.activate` names it, no peer surface reads a version) [V]. Reviewed: #326, #493, #908. Shipped: green on f89b294. Unchanged since 10-23 [V git log].

criteria.text: The step gates publishing each new Page, not creating it, selling and hosting alike; creating and editing a draft never asks; browsing, responding, following and attending are untouched
criteria.note: `group.activate` is the only gate; `group.create` and `update_draft` never ask [V]. Checked: `[guards F082.4]` in `activate.test.ts` [V]. Reviewed: #326 and #493. Shipped: green on 96b0ea6. Unchanged since 10-23 [V]. Smoked: no route for the publish card.

criteria.text: No string in the step asks the member to classify themselves as a business, uses legal or tax language, or asks for legal-entity information
criteria.note: The only step strings are the checklist labels, the missing-parts line and 'By posting you agree to the Terms'; none classifies the member, uses legal or tax language, or asks for entity information [V BeforeYouPublish.tsx]. #1135 deleted the old `[guards F082.5]` scan with the rules block, so no guard stands (#1202; #581 is the F060 sibling). Reviewed: #493 did; #1135 rewrote the step and is 'pending', so no. Shipped: green on 3df9260.

criteria.text: The rules are versioned: a member who agreed to an earlier version agrees again before they next publish; each agreement is recorded with version and timestamp, seen only by Don and operators
criteria.note: `RULES_VERSION` (still 1; #1135 changed the surface, not the version) is compared on every publish and the agreement row is written in the publish transaction; the table has RLS on and no client policy [V]. Checked: `activate.test.ts` `[guards F082.6]` x2 (earlier version refused, row recorded) and `create/actions.test.ts` `[guards F082.6]`; 'only operators read it' is F082.3's guard [V]. Reviewed: #493. Shipped: green on 96b0ea6. Note the word 'rules' now means the Terms (see 2b).

criteria.text: The rules are viewable with one click, whether or not the member is taking the step
criteria.note: Since #1135 the rules live in the Terms: `/rules` answers 301 to `/terms` (`next.config.ts`), and `/terms` is one click from the Publish card, signup, onboarding, the desktop footer and the landing page [V grep]; the You > Rules row (#772) is gone. Treating the Terms as 'the rules' follows Don's 10-31 change (see 2b). Checked: `BeforeYouPublish.test.tsx` and `shell.test.tsx` assert the link and the redirect, unmarked; the old `[guards F082.7]` checks were deleted (#1204). Reviewed: #772 was review-skipped and #1135 is pending. Shipped: green on 3df9260. Smoked: `/terms` has no LIVE_PATHS entry.

criteria.text: Publishing a Page requires a name, a location (address or area) and a description, with the rules agreement and at least one tag; a photo is optional and a Page without one shows its kind default image
criteria.note: `group.activate` requires name (or business display name), anchor location and description for every kind; a tag is no longer asked of the member but 'Listed under' is filled from the Page's words, else Neighborhood life, so a Page is never published unlisted (#1181, plan #273 B, `Reviewed by:` second session); the checklist marks the photo optional; `DefaultArt` stands in without one [V activate.ts, BeforeYouPublish.tsx]. Checked: `[guards F082.8]` in `tests/f082-rules-before-publish-db.test.tsx`, which now also asserts the suggested listing [V]. Reviewed: #326, #493, #908, #1181. Shipped: green on f89b294 and 591ab70.

criteria.text: One of the rules is the photo rule: the member agrees not to post pictures of children (draft wording, versioned like the rest)
criteria.note: The photo rule is in the Terms: 'No photos of kids, ever. Nothing involving kids, pets or anyone who can't speak up for themselves.' (`src/lib/text-pages.ts`), agreed with the Terms line at publish [V]. Draft wording ([public-is-draft]); the scenario's draft sentence and 'with its reason' form are gone. Checked: `[guards F082.9]` in `tests/f082-rules-before-publish-db.test.tsx` (rewritten in #1135 to match the Terms) and `text-pages.test.ts` [V]. Reviewed: the text moved with #1135 ('second session pending'), so no. Shipped: green on 3df9260.
